title: The Next Evolution of Software Developers
excerpt: The next evolution of software developers: from implementation to intent, orchestration, and...
content_html:
The next evolution of software developers: from implementation to intent, orchestration, and ownership.

Over the last few months, I've read countless articles debating whether AI will replace software developers. Some predict the end of programming as we know it, while others argue that nothing significant will change.

Personally, I think both perspectives miss the point.

The real transformation isn't that AI can write code. We already know it can. The interesting question is what happens to our profession when writing code is no longer the hardest part of building software.

When I look back at the history of software engineering, I notice a recurring pattern. Every major innovation has raised the level of abstraction.

We moved from Assembly to high-level languages. We stopped managing memory manually. Frameworks abstracted away repetitive boilerplate. Cloud platforms removed much of the operational complexity that once required dedicated teams.

Every step made developers more productive by allowing them to focus less on implementation and more on solving problems.

AI feels like the next step in that same evolution.
Instead of replacing software developers, AI is moving us one level higher in the abstraction stack.

The shift isn't from developers to AI. It's from writing code to defining intent, orchestrating systems, and owning outcomes.

AI isn't the disruption. Abstraction is.

When I started my career, software development revolved around the IDE. A typical day meant creating classes, implementing functions, fixing bugs, and gradually evolving a codebase one commit at a time.

The code was the way we expressed our intentions to computers.

As software systems became larger, something interesting happened. Understanding existing code became just as valuable as writing new code.

Entire consulting projects revolved around taking ownership of legacy applications, understanding how they worked, fixing bugs without introducing regressions, and safely adding new functionality.

Reading code became a highly valuable skill because understanding the system was ultimately more important than producing another hundred lines of PHP or Java.

Today, I believe we're witnessing another transition.

The abstraction layer is moving again.

Every major evolution in software engineering has raised the level of abstraction. AI is simply the next step.

Developers are moving up the abstraction stack

More and more of my time is spent understanding problems before thinking about implementation.

I define requirements, clarify constraints, evaluate trade-offs, design architectures, connect existing platforms, review AI-generated code, and decide where deterministic software is sufficient and where AI reasoning genuinely creates value.

Writing code is still part of my work, but it is no longer necessarily the activity that creates the most value.

This is why I don't believe software developers are disappearing. I believe we're moving to another layer of the stack.

The skills and technical knowledge accumulated over years don't suddenly become irrelevant. Quite the opposite. They allow us to operate at this higher level because we can understand what is happening underneath the abstractions we use.

The role becomes less about translating every decision manually into code and more about making those decisions in the first place.

Developers aren't becoming less technical. They're applying their technical skills at a higher level of abstraction.

The IDE is no longer the center of our work

For decades, the IDE was our primary interface for creating software.

Increasingly, that interface is changing.

We can describe what we want to build, provide context, define requirements and constraints, and let systems produce part of the implementation for us. Whether those systems are Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or tools that don't even exist yet is almost secondary.

The interesting part is the shift in our interaction with software development.

The IDE doesn't disappear. I still expect to open files, inspect code, debug problems, review implementations, and occasionally write code directly.

But its role changes.

Instead of being the place where every line of software originates, it increasingly becomes one of the places where generated implementations are inspected, understood, validated, and evolved.

Our primary interface is gradually shifting from implementation toward intent.

The IDE used to be where software was created. Increasingly, it's becoming where software is reviewed.

The economics of software are changing

This transition also changes the economics of software development.

Yes, AI has a cost. Tokens aren't free.

But if you compare the cost of generating, reviewing, and iterating on code with the cost of performing the same work entirely manually, it's difficult to ignore where the industry is heading.

Implementation is becoming dramatically cheaper than it has ever been.

I don't think that means software becomes less valuable. If anything, it means we'll build significantly more software.

Ideas that were previously too expensive to implement suddenly become viable. Small businesses can automate processes that never justified custom software before. Freelancers can build products that previously required entire engineering teams. Startups can experiment faster because the cost of implementation continues to decrease.

And all this new software still needs somewhere to live.

It needs reliable infrastructure, deployment platforms, observability, authentication, content management, payments, monitoring, storage, databases, integrations, and security.

Platforms such as Laravel Cloud, Vercel, Netlify, Storyblok, Supabase, Stripe, and many others don't become less relevant because AI can generate code. They provide the building blocks that allow increasingly more ideas to become real products.

Software creation becomes cheaper, but operating, evolving, and taking responsibility for that software doesn't magically disappear.

And that leads to what I believe is one of the most important changes in our profession.

Implementation is becoming cheaper. Ownership is becoming more valuable.

Ownership is the new differentiator

Let's imagine a future where AI generates every single line of code in a project.

Who owns that software?

Not the AI.

Someone still owns the architecture. Someone decides how services communicate. Someone is responsible for security, scalability, reliability, compliance, performance, cost, and long-term maintainability.

Someone decides which trade-offs are acceptable, which technical debt can wait, and which technical debt has become dangerous.

Someone needs to understand why a particular architectural decision was made and whether that decision still makes sense six months later.

Someone is ultimately accountable when production fails at two o'clock in the morning.

And that someone will rarely be an individual in a significant software product. It will be people and teams taking ownership of different parts of the system.

Generating code doesn't mean owning a product.

Those are two very different responsibilities.

In fact, I believe the cheaper the implementation becomes, the more valuable ownership becomes. As AI removes friction from producing software, the quality of architectural, functional, and non-functional decisions becomes a stronger differentiator.

Making software has never been just about producing code. It's about making decisions and accepting responsibility for their consequences.

Code can be generated. Responsibility cannot.

Modern software is becoming probabilistic

There's another fascinating change happening inside the applications themselves.

For decades, most business logic was deterministic. Given the same input and the same state, we expected the same output every single time.

AI introduces something different.

Applications can now reason at runtime, interpret natural language, classify information, summarize documents, generate content, select tools, and make decisions based on context.

Parts of our systems are becoming probabilistic rather than purely deterministic.

This creates an entirely new category of engineering decisions.

Where should we use an LLM, and where is a traditional function the better solution? How do we test something whose output can legitimately change? How do we evaluate its quality? How do we monitor it in production? How much variability is acceptable? What happens when the model produces an unexpected result?

The more intelligence we introduce at runtime, the more important these questions become.

AI doesn't eliminate engineering decisions by providing an intelligent component.

It creates new ones.

AI doesn't remove engineering decisions. It creates new ones.

The biggest opportunity for software developers

This is the part of this evolution that makes me optimistic.

For years, many freelancers and consultants essentially sold implementation.

A client needed a feature, we estimated the work, implemented it, and charged for the time required to produce it.

When implementation becomes cheaper, that model obviously changes.

But I don't necessarily see that as a problem.

I see an opportunity.

A single experienced developer can increasingly combine AI capabilities, cloud infrastructure, authentication providers, payment platforms, headless CMSs, deployment services, databases, and specialized APIs to build products that only a few years ago would have required an entire team.

The differentiator is no longer simply the ability to implement every component.

It's knowing which components to use, how to combine them, what should be custom, what shouldn't be built at all, and most importantly, which problem is actually worth solving.

That moves developers much closer to the product.

Instead of selling only implementation, we can sell solutions. Instead of receiving specifications and translating them into code, we can participate in defining what should be built and take ownership of the result.

That's why I like the word builder.

A builder isn't defined by how much code they personally write.

A builder understands the problem, designs the solution, chooses the right tools, orchestrates the pieces, evaluates the result, and owns what happens next.

Looking at our profession from this perspective, I don't think the future software developer creates less value.

I think we create value differently.

Less implementation, more intent.

Less typing, more decision-making.

More orchestration.

More ownership.

Every major shift in our industry has raised the level of abstraction without removing the need for great engineers. AI is doing the same thing, but perhaps at a scale and speed we haven't experienced before.

It's not asking us to become less technical. It's giving us the opportunity to apply our technical knowledge at a higher level, where understanding systems, making good decisions, and taking ownership matter even more.

That's not the end of software development.

It's the next evolution of software developers.

sentences.zh: 开发人员的技术水平并没有降低。

sentences.en: They're applying their technical skills at a higher level of abstraction.
sentences.zh: 他们正在更高的抽象层次上应用他们的技术技能。

blocks.html_en: The IDE is no longer the center of our work

sentences.en: The IDE is no longer the center of our work
sentences.zh: IDE 不再是我们工作的中心

blocks.html_en: For decades, the IDE was our primary interface for creating software.

sentences.en: For decades, the IDE was our primary interface for creating software.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，IDE 一直是我们创建软件的主要界面。

blocks.html_en: Increasingly, that interface is changing.

sentences.en: Increasingly, that interface is changing.
sentences.zh: 该界面正在逐渐发生变化。

blocks.html_en: We can describe what we want to build, provide context, define requirements and constraints, and let systems produce part of the implementation for us. Whether those systems are Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or tools that don't even exist yet is almost secondary.

sentences.en: We can describe what we want to build, provide context, define requirements and constraints, and let systems produce part of the implementation for us.
sentences.zh: 我们可以描述我们想要构建的内容，提供上下文，定义需求和约束，并让系统为我们生成部分实现。

sentences.en: Whether those systems are Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or tools that don't even exist yet is almost secondary.
sentences.zh: 这些系统是 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 还是尚不存在的工具几乎都是次要的。

blocks.html_en: The interesting part is the shift in our interaction with software development.

sentences.en: The interesting part is the shift in our interaction with software development.
sentences.zh: 有趣的部分是我们与软件开发交互的转变。

blocks.html_en: The IDE doesn't disappear. I still expect to open files, inspect code, debug problems, review implementations, and occasionally write code directly.

sentences.en: The IDE doesn't disappear.
sentences.zh: IDE 并没有消失。

sentences.en: I still expect to open files, inspect code, debug problems, review implementations, and occasionally write code directly.
sentences.zh: 我仍然希望打开文件、检查代码、调试问题、审查实现，有时甚至直接编写代码。

blocks.html_en: But its role changes.

sentences.en: But its role changes.
sentences.zh: 但它的角色发生了变化。

blocks.html_en: Instead of being the place where every line of software originates, it increasingly becomes one of the places where generated implementations are inspected, understood, validated, and evolved.

sentences.en: Instead of being the place where every line of software originates, it increasingly becomes one of the places where generated implementations are inspected, understood, validated, and evolved.
sentences.zh: 它不再是每一行软件的起源地，而是越来越成为检查、理解、验证和发展生成的实现的地方之一。

blocks.html_en: Our primary interface is gradually shifting from implementation toward intent.

sentences.en: Our primary interface is gradually shifting from implementation toward intent.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要界面正在逐渐从实现转向意图。

blocks.html_en: The IDE used to be where software was created. Increasingly, it's becoming where software is reviewed.

sentences.en: The IDE used to be where software was created.
sentences.zh: IDE 曾经是创建软件的地方。

sentences.en: Increasingly, it's becoming where software is reviewed.
sentences.zh: 它越来越成为软件审查的地方。

blocks.html_en: The IDE used to be where software was created. Increasingly, it's becoming where software is reviewed.

sentences.en: The IDE used to be where software was created.
sentences.zh: IDE 曾经是创建软件的地方。

sentences.en: Increasingly, it's becoming where software is reviewed.
sentences.zh: 它越来越成为软件审查的地方。

blocks.html_en: The economics of software are changing

sentences.en: The economics of software are changing
sentences.zh: 软件经济学正在发生变化

blocks.html_en: This transition also changes the economics of software development.

sentences.en: This transition also changes the economics of software development.
sentences.zh: 这种转变也改变了软件开发的经济学。

blocks.html_en: Yes, AI has a cost. Tokens aren't free.

sentences.en: Yes, AI has a cost.
sentences.zh: 是的，人工智能是有成本的。

sentences.en: Tokens aren't free.
sentences.zh: 代币不是免费的。

blocks.html_en: But if you compare the cost of generating, reviewing, and iterating on code with the cost of performing the same work entirely manually, it's difficult to ignore where the industry is heading.

sentences.en: But if you compare the cost of generating, reviewing, and iterating on code with the cost of performing the same work entirely manually, it's difficult to ignore where the industry is heading.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果将生成、审查和迭代代码的成本与完全手动执行相同工作的成本进行比较，就很难忽视该行业的发展方向。

blocks.html_en: Implementation is becoming dramatically cheaper than it has ever been.

sentences.en: Implementation is becoming dramatically cheaper than it has ever been.
sentences.zh: 实施成本比以往任何时候都低得多。

blocks.html_en: I don't think that means software becomes less valuable. If anything, it means we'll build significantly more software.

sentences.en: I don't think that means software becomes less valuable.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这意味着软件的价值会降低。

sentences.en: If anything, it means we'll build significantly more software.
sentences.zh: 如果有的话，那就意味着我们将构建更多的软件。

blocks.html_en: Ideas that were previously too expensive to implement suddenly become viable. Small businesses can automate processes that never justified custom software before. Freelancers can build products that previously required entire engineering teams. Startups can experiment faster because the cost of implementation continues to decrease.

sentences.en: Ideas that were previously too expensive to implement suddenly become viable.
sentences.zh: 以前实施起来成本太高的想法突然变得可行。

sentences.en: Small businesses can automate processes that never justified custom software before.
sentences.zh: 小型企业可以实现以前从未证明定制软件合理的流程自动化。

sentences.en: Freelancers can build products that previously required entire engineering teams.
sentences.zh: 自由职业者可以构建以前需要整个工程团队的产品。

sentences.en: Startups can experiment faster because the cost of implementation continues to decrease.
sentences.zh: 由于实施成本不断降低，初创公司可以更快地进行实验。

blocks.html_en: And all this new software still needs somewhere to live.

sentences.en: And all this new software still needs somewhere to live.
sentences.zh: 所有这些新软件仍然需要一个生存的地方。

blocks.html_en: It needs reliable infrastructure, deployment platforms, observability, authentication, content management, payments, monitoring, storage, databases, integrations, and security.

sentences.en: It needs reliable infrastructure, deployment platforms, observability, authentication, content management, payments, monitoring, storage, databases, integrations, and security.
sentences.zh: 它需要可靠的基础设施、部署平台、可观察性、身份验证、内容管理、支付、监控、存储、数据库、集成和安全性。

blocks.html_en: Platforms such as Laravel Cloud, Vercel, Netlify, Storyblok, Supabase, Stripe, and many others don't become less relevant because AI can generate code. They provide the building blocks that allow increasingly more ideas to become real products.

sentences.en: Platforms such as Laravel Cloud, Vercel, Netlify, Storyblok, Supabase, Stripe, and many others don't become less relevant because AI can generate code.
sentences.zh: Laravel Cloud、Vercel、Netlify、Storyblok、Supabase、Stripe 等平台的相关性并没有因为人工智能可以生成代码而变得不那么重要。

sentences.en: They provide the building blocks that allow increasingly more ideas to become real products.
sentences.zh: 它们提供了构建模块，使越来越多的想法成为真正的产品。

blocks.html_en: Software creation becomes cheaper, but operating, evolving, and taking responsibility for that software doesn't magically disappear.

sentences.en: Software creation becomes cheaper, but operating, evolving, and taking responsibility for that software doesn't magically disappear.
sentences.zh: 软件的创建变得更加便宜，但是软件的运营、发展和责任并没有神奇地消失。

blocks.html_en: And that leads to what I believe is one of the most important changes in our profession.

sentences.en: And that leads to what I believe is one of the most important changes in our profession.
sentences.zh: 我认为这导致了我们职业中最重要的变化之一。

blocks.html_en: Implementation is becoming cheaper. Ownership is becoming more valuable.

sentences.en: Implementation is becoming cheaper.
sentences.zh: 实施变得越来越便宜。

sentences.en: Ownership is becoming more valuable.
sentences.zh: 所有权变得越来越有价值。

blocks.html_en: Implementation is becoming cheaper. Ownership is becoming more valuable.

sentences.en: Implementation is becoming cheaper.
sentences.zh: 实施变得越来越便宜。

sentences.en: Ownership is becoming more valuable.
sentences.zh: 所有权变得越来越有价值。

blocks.html_en: Ownership is the new differentiator

sentences.en: Ownership is the new differentiator
sentences.zh: 所有权是新的差异化因素

blocks.html_en: Let's imagine a future where AI generates every single line of code in a project.

sentences.en: Let's imagine a future where AI generates every single line of code in a project.
sentences.zh: 让我们想象一下未来，人工智能会生成项目中的每一行代码。

blocks.html_en: Who owns that software?

sentences.en: Who owns that software?
sentences.zh: 谁拥有该软件？

blocks.html_en: Not the AI.

sentences.en: Not the AI.
sentences.zh: 不是人工智能。

blocks.html_en: Someone still owns the architecture. Someone decides how services communicate. Someone is responsible for security, scalability, reliability, compliance, performance, cost, and long-term maintainability.

sentences.en: Someone still owns the architecture.
sentences.zh: 有人仍然拥有该建筑。

sentences.en: Someone decides how services communicate.
sentences.zh: 有人决定服务如何通信。

sentences.en: Someone is responsible for security, scalability, reliability, compliance, performance, cost, and long-term maintainability.
sentences.zh: 有人负责安全性、可扩展性、可靠性、合规性、性能、成本和长期可维护性。

blocks.html_en: Someone decides which trade-offs are acceptable, which technical debt can wait, and which technical debt has become dangerous.

sentences.en: Someone decides which trade-offs are acceptable, which technical debt can wait, and which technical debt has become dangerous.
sentences.zh: 有人决定哪些权衡是可以接受的，哪些技术债务可以等待，哪些技术债务已经变得危险。

blocks.html_en: Someone needs to understand why a particular architectural decision was made and whether that decision still makes sense six months later.

sentences.en: Someone needs to understand why a particular architectural decision was made and whether that decision still makes sense six months later.
sentences.zh: 有人需要了解为什么做出特定的架构决策以及该决策在六个月后是否仍然有意义。

blocks.html_en: Someone is ultimately accountable when production fails at two o'clock in the morning.

sentences.en: Someone is ultimately accountable when production fails at two o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 凌晨两点生产失败最终要有人承担责任。

blocks.html_en: And that someone will rarely be an individual in a significant software product. It will be people and teams taking ownership of different parts of the system.

sentences.en: And that someone will rarely be an individual in a significant software product.
sentences.zh: 而且很少有人是重要软件产品中的个体。

sentences.en: It will be people and teams taking ownership of different parts of the system.
sentences.zh: 人员和团队将拥有系统不同部分的所有权。

blocks.html_en: Generating code doesn't mean owning a product.

sentences.en: Generating code doesn't mean owning a product.
sentences.zh: 生成代码并不意味着拥有产品。

blocks.html_en: Those are two very different responsibilities.

sentences.en: Those are two very different responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 这是两种截然不同的责任。

blocks.html_en: In fact, I believe the cheaper the implementation becomes, the more valuable ownership becomes. As AI removes friction from producing software, the quality of architectural, functional, and non-functional decisions becomes a stronger differentiator.

sentences.en: In fact, I believe the cheaper the implementation becomes, the more valuable ownership becomes.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我相信实施成本越低，所有权就越有价值。

sentences.en: As AI removes friction from producing software, the quality of architectural, functional, and non-functional decisions becomes a stronger differentiator.
sentences.zh: 随着人工智能消除了软件生产过程中的摩擦，架构、功能和非功能决策的质量成为更强大的差异化因素。

blocks.html_en: Making software has never been just about producing code. It's about making decisions and accepting responsibility for their consequences.

sentences.en: Making software has never been just about producing code.
sentences.zh: 制作软件从来不仅仅是生成代码。

sentences.en: It's about making decisions and accepting responsibility for their consequences.
sentences.zh: 这是关于做出决定并对其后果承担责任。

blocks.html_en: Code can be generated. Responsibility cannot.

sentences.en: Code can be generated.
sentences.zh: 可以生成代码。

sentences.en: Responsibility cannot.
sentences.zh: 责任不能。

blocks.html_en: Code can be generated. Responsibility cannot.

sentences.en: Code can be generated.
sentences.zh: 可以生成代码。

sentences.en: Responsibility cannot.
sentences.zh: 责任不能。

blocks.html_en: Modern software is becoming probabilistic

sentences.en: Modern software is becoming probabilistic
sentences.zh: 现代软件正在变得概率化

blocks.html_en: There's another fascinating change happening inside the applications themselves.

sentences.en: There's another fascinating change happening inside the applications themselves.
sentences.zh: 应用程序本身内部还发生了另一个令人着迷的变化。

blocks.html_en: For decades, most business logic was deterministic. Given the same input and the same state, we expected the same output every single time.

sentences.en: For decades, most business logic was deterministic.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，大多数业务逻辑都是确定性的。

sentences.en: Given the same input and the same state, we expected the same output every single time.
sentences.zh: 给定相同的输入和相同的状态，我们每次都期望相同的输出。

blocks.html_en: AI introduces something different.

sentences.en: AI introduces something different.
sentences.zh: 人工智能引入了一些不同的东西。

blocks.html_en: Applications can now reason at runtime, interpret natural language, classify information, summarize documents, generate content, select tools, and make decisions based on context.

sentences.en: Applications can now reason at runtime, interpret natural language, classify information, summarize documents, generate content, select tools, and make decisions based on context.
sentences.zh: 应用程序现在可以在运行时进行推理、解释自然语言、对信息进行分类、总结文档、生成内容、选择工具并根据上下文做出决策。

blocks.html_en: Parts of our systems are becoming probabilistic rather than purely deterministic.

sentences.en: Parts of our systems are becoming probabilistic rather than purely deterministic.
sentences.zh: 我们系统的某些部分正在变得概率性而非纯粹的确定性。

blocks.html_en: This creates an entirely new category of engineering decisions.

sentences.en: This creates an entirely new category of engineering decisions.
sentences.zh: 这创造了一个全新的工程决策类别。

blocks.html_en: Where should we use an LLM, and where is a traditional function the better solution? How do we test something whose output can legitimately change? How do we evaluate its quality? How do we monitor it in production? How much variability is acceptable? What happens when the model produces an unexpected result?

sentences.en: Where should we use an LLM, and where is a traditional function the better solution?
sentences.zh: 我们应该在哪里使用法学硕士，传统职能在哪里是更好的解决方案？

sentences.en: How do we test something whose output can legitimately change?
sentences.zh: 我们如何测试输出可以合法改变的东西？

sentences.en: How do we evaluate its quality?
sentences.zh: 我们如何评价它的质量？

sentences.en: How do we monitor it in production?
sentences.zh: 我们如何在生产中对其进行监控？

sentences.en: How much variability is acceptable?
sentences.zh: 多少变化是可以接受的？

sentences.en: What happens when the model produces an unexpected result?
sentences.zh: 当模型产生意外结果时会发生什么？

blocks.html_en: The more intelligence we introduce at runtime, the more important these questions become.

sentences.en: The more intelligence we introduce at runtime, the more important these questions become.
sentences.zh: 我们在运行时引入的智能越多，这些问题就变得越重要。

blocks.html_en: AI doesn't eliminate engineering decisions by providing an intelligent component.

sentences.en: AI doesn't eliminate engineering decisions by providing an intelligent component.
sentences.zh: 人工智能并不会通过提供智能组件来消除工程决策。

blocks.html_en: It creates new ones.

sentences.en: It creates new ones.
sentences.zh: 它创造了新的。

blocks.html_en: AI doesn't remove engineering decisions. It creates new ones.

sentences.en: AI doesn't remove engineering decisions.
sentences.zh: 人工智能不会消除工程决策。

sentences.en: It creates new ones.
sentences.zh: 它创造了新的。

blocks.html_en: AI doesn't remove engineering decisions. It creates new ones.

sentences.en: AI doesn't remove engineering decisions.
sentences.zh: 人工智能不会消除工程决策。

sentences.en: It creates new ones.
sentences.zh: 它创造了新的。

blocks.html_en: The biggest opportunity for software developers

sentences.en: The biggest opportunity for software developers
sentences.zh: 软件开发人员最大的机会

blocks.html_en: This is the part of this evolution that makes me optimistic.

sentences.en: This is the part of this evolution that makes me optimistic.
sentences.zh: 这是这种演变中让我感到乐观的部分。

blocks.html_en: For years, many freelancers and consultants essentially sold implementation.

sentences.en: For years, many freelancers and consultants essentially sold implementation.
sentences.zh: 多年来，许多自由职业者和顾问基本上都是在销售实施。

blocks.html_en: A client needed a feature, we estimated the work, implemented it, and charged for the time required to produce it.

sentences.en: A client needed a feature, we estimated the work, implemented it, and charged for the time required to produce it.
sentences.zh: 客户需要一项功能，我们评估工作量，实施它，并按生产它所需的时间收费。

blocks.html_en: When implementation becomes cheaper, that model obviously changes.

sentences.en: When implementation becomes cheaper, that model obviously changes.
sentences.zh: 当实施变得更便宜时，该模型显然会发生变化。

blocks.html_en: But I don't necessarily see that as a problem.

sentences.en: But I don't necessarily see that as a problem.
sentences.zh: 但我不一定认为这是一个问题。

blocks.html_en: I see an opportunity.

sentences.en: I see an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我看到了一个机会。

blocks.html_en: A single experienced developer can increasingly combine AI capabilities, cloud infrastructure, authentication providers, payment platforms, headless CMSs, deployment services, databases, and specialized APIs to build products that only a few years ago would have required an entire team.

sentences.en: A single experienced developer can increasingly combine AI capabilities, cloud infrastructure, authentication providers, payment platforms, headless CMSs, deployment services, databases, and specialized APIs to build products that only a few years ago would have required an entire team.
sentences.zh: 经验丰富的开发人员可以越来越多地结合人工智能功能、云基础设施、身份验证提供商、支付平台、无头 CMS、部署服务、数据库和专用 API 来构建几年前需要整个团队才能完成的产品。

blocks.html_en: The differentiator is no longer simply the ability to implement every component.

sentences.en: The differentiator is no longer simply the ability to implement every component.
sentences.zh: 差异化因素不再仅仅是实现每个组件的能力。

blocks.html_en: It's knowing which components to use, how to combine them, what should be custom, what shouldn't be built at all, and most importantly, which problem is actually worth solving.

sentences.en: It's knowing which components to use, how to combine them, what should be custom, what shouldn't be built at all, and most importantly, which problem is actually worth solving.
sentences.zh: 它知道要使用哪些组件，如何组合它们，什么应该自定义，什么根本不应该构建，最重要的是，哪个问题实际上值得解决。

blocks.html_en: That moves developers much closer to the product.

sentences.en: That moves developers much closer to the product.
sentences.zh: 这使开发人员更加接近产品。

blocks.html_en: Instead of selling only implementation, we can sell solutions. Instead of receiving specifications and translating them into code, we can participate in defining what should be built and take ownership of the result.

sentences.en: Instead of selling only implementation, we can sell solutions.
sentences.zh: 我们可以销售解决方案，而不是只销售实施。

sentences.en: Instead of receiving specifications and translating them into code, we can participate in defining what should be built and take ownership of the result.
sentences.zh: 我们可以参与定义应该构建的内容并拥有结果，而不是接收规范并将其转换为代码。

blocks.html_en: That's why I like the word builder.

sentences.en: That's why I like the word builder.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我喜欢“构建者”这个词。

blocks.html_en: A builder isn't defined by how much code they personally write.

sentences.en: A builder isn't defined by how much code they personally write.
sentences.zh: 构建者并不是由他们亲自编写了多少代码来定义的。

blocks.html_en: A builder understands the problem, designs the solution, chooses the right tools, orchestrates the pieces, evaluates the result, and owns what happens next.

sentences.en: A builder understands the problem, designs the solution, chooses the right tools, orchestrates the pieces, evaluates the result, and owns what happens next.
sentences.zh: 构建者了解问题、设计解决方案、选择正确的工具、编排各个部分、评估结果并掌控接下来发生的事情。

blocks.html_en: Looking at our profession from this perspective, I don't think the future software developer creates less value.

sentences.en: Looking at our profession from this perspective, I don't think the future software developer creates less value.
sentences.zh: 从这个角度来看我们的职业，我不认为未来的软件开发人员创造的价值会减少。

blocks.html_en: I think we create value differently.

sentences.en: I think we create value differently.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们创造价值的方式不同。

blocks.html_en: Less implementation, more intent.

sentences.en: Less implementation, more intent.
sentences.zh: 更少的执行，更多的意图。

blocks.html_en: Less typing, more decision-making.

sentences.en: Less typing, more decision-making.
sentences.zh: 更少的打字，更多的决策。

blocks.html_en: More orchestration.

sentences.en: More orchestration.
sentences.zh: 更多编排。

blocks.html_en: More ownership.

sentences.en: More ownership.
sentences.zh: 更多所有权。

blocks.html_en: Every major shift in our industry has raised the level of abstraction without removing the need for great engineers. AI is doing the same thing, but perhaps at a scale and speed we haven't experienced before.

sentences.en: Every major shift in our industry has raised the level of abstraction without removing the need for great engineers.
sentences.zh: 我们行业的每一次重大转变都提高了抽象水平，但并没有消除对优秀工程师的需求。

sentences.en: AI is doing the same thing, but perhaps at a scale and speed we haven't experienced before.
sentences.zh: 人工智能正在做同样的事情，但其规模和速度可能是我们以前从未经历过的。

blocks.html_en: It's not asking us to become less technical. It's giving us the opportunity to apply our technical knowledge at a higher level, where understanding systems, making good decisions, and taking ownership matter even more.

sentences.en: It's not asking us to become less technical.
sentences.zh: 它并不是要求我们变得不那么技术化。

sentences.en: It's giving us the opportunity to apply our technical knowledge at a higher level, where understanding systems, making good decisions, and taking ownership matter even more.
sentences.zh: 它让我们有机会在更高的水平上应用我们的技术知识，在这个水平上，理解系统、做出正确的决策和掌握所有权更加重要。

blocks.html_en: That's not the end of software development.

sentences.en: That's not the end of software development.
sentences.zh: 这并不是软件开发的结束。

blocks.html_en: It's the next evolution of software developers.

sentences.en: It's the next evolution of software developers.
sentences.zh: 这是软件开发人员的下一个发展。

blocks.html_en: It's the next evolution of software developers.

sentences.en: It's the next evolution of software developers.
sentences.zh: 这是软件开发人员的下一个发展。

软件开发人员的下一个演变：从实施到意图、编排和所有权。

在过去的几个月里，我读了无数关于人工智能是否会取代软件开发人员的文章。 一些人预测我们所知道的编程的终结，而另一些人则认为不会有任何重大改变。

就我个人而言，我认为这两种观点都没有抓住要点。

真正的转变并不是人工智能可以编写代码。 我们已经知道它可以。 有趣的问题是，当编写代码不再是构建软件中最困难的部分时，我们的职业会发生什么。

当我回顾软件工程的历史时，我注意到一个反复出现的模式。 每一项重大创新都提高了抽象层次。

我们从汇编语言转向高级语言。 我们停止手动管理内存。 框架抽象出了重复的样板文件。 云平台消除了许多曾经需要专门团队的操作复杂性。

每一步都使开发人员能够减少对实施的关注，而更多地关注解决问题，从而提高工作效率。

人工智能感觉就像是同一进化的下一步。 人工智能并没有取代软件开发人员，而是将我们的抽象堆栈提升了一个层次。

这种转变不是从开发人员到人工智能的。 从编写代码到定义意图、编排系统和拥有结果。

人工智能并不是颠覆。 抽象是。

当我开始我的职业生涯时，软件开发是围绕 IDE 进行的。 典型的一天意味着创建类、实现功能、修复错误，并逐步发展代码库，一次提交一个。

代码是我们向计算机表达意图的方式。

随着软件系统变得越来越大，一些有趣的事情发生了。 理解现有代码变得与编写新代码一样有价值。

整个咨询项目围绕着获得遗留应用程序的所有权、了解它们的工作原理、修复错误而不引入回归以及安全地添加新功能。

阅读代码成为一项非常有价值的技能，因为理解系统最终比编写另外一百行 PHP 或 Java 更重要。

今天，我相信我们正在见证另一个转变。

抽象层又开始动起来了。

软件工程的每一次重大发展都提高了抽象级别。 人工智能只是下一步。

开发人员正在提升抽象堆栈

我越来越多的时间花在了在考虑实施之前理解问题。

我定义需求，澄清约束，评估权衡，设计架构，连接现有平台，审查人工智能生成的代码，并决定确定性软件在哪里足够以及人工智能推理在哪里真正创造价值。

编写代码仍然是我工作的一部分，但它不再一定是创造最大价值的活动。

这就是为什么我不相信软件开发人员正在消失。 我相信我们正在转向堆栈的另一层。

多年积累的技能和技术知识不会突然变得无关紧要。 恰恰相反。 它们使我们能够在更高的层面上进行操作，因为我们可以理解我们使用的抽象背后正在发生什么。

这个角色不再是手动将每个决策翻译成代码，而是首先做出这些决策。

开发人员的技术水平并没有降低。 他们正在更高的抽象层次上应用他们的技术技能。

IDE 不再是我们工作的中心

几十年来，IDE 一直是我们创建软件的主要界面。

该界面正在逐渐发生变化。

我们可以描述我们想要构建的内容，提供上下文，定义需求和约束，并让系统为我们生成部分实现。 这些系统是 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 还是尚不存在的工具几乎都是次要的。

有趣的部分是我们与软件开发交互的转变。

IDE 并没有消失。 我仍然希望打开文件、检查代码、调试问题、审查实现，有时甚至直接编写代码。

但它的角色发生了变化。

它不再是每一行软件的起源地，而是越来越成为检查、理解、验证和发展生成的实现的地方之一。

我们的主要界面正在逐渐从实现转向意图。

IDE 曾经是创建软件的地方。 它越来越成为软件审查的地方。

软件经济学正在发生变化

这种转变也改变了软件开发的经济学。

是的，人工智能是有成本的。 代币不是免费的。

但是，如果将生成、审查和迭代代码的成本与完全手动执行相同工作的成本进行比较，就很难忽视该行业的发展方向。

实施成本比以往任何时候都低得多。

我不认为这意味着软件的价值会降低。 如果有的话，那就意味着我们将构建更多的软件。

以前实施起来成本太高的想法突然变得可行。 小型企业可以实现以前从未证明定制软件合理的流程自动化。 自由职业者可以构建以前需要整个工程团队的产品。 由于实施成本不断降低，初创公司可以更快地进行实验。

所有这些新软件仍然需要一个生存的地方。

它需要可靠的基础设施、部署平台、可观察性、身份验证、内容管理、支付、监控、存储、数据库、集成和安全性。

Laravel Cloud、Vercel、Netlify、Storyblok、Supabase、Stripe 等平台的相关性并没有因为人工智能可以生成代码而变得不那么重要。 它们提供了构建模块，使越来越多的想法成为真正的产品。

软件的创建变得更加便宜，但是软件的运营、发展和责任并没有神奇地消失。

我认为这导致了我们职业中最重要的变化之一。

实施变得越来越便宜。 所有权变得越来越有价值。

所有权是新的差异化因素

让我们想象一下未来，人工智能会生成项目中的每一行代码。

谁拥有该软件？

不是人工智能。

有人仍然拥有该建筑。 有人决定服务如何通信。 有人负责安全性、可扩展性、可靠性、合规性、性能、成本和长期可维护性。

有人决定哪些权衡是可以接受的，哪些技术债务可以等待，哪些技术债务已经变得危险。

有人需要了解为什么做出特定的架构决策以及该决策在六个月后是否仍然有意义。

凌晨两点生产失败最终要有人承担责任。

而且很少有人是重要软件产品中的个体。 人员和团队将拥有系统不同部分的所有权。

生成代码并不意味着拥有产品。

这是两种截然不同的责任。

事实上，我相信实施成本越低，所有权就越有价值。 随着人工智能消除了软件生产过程中的摩擦，架构、功能和非功能决策的质量成为更强大的差异化因素。

制作软件从来不仅仅是生成代码。 这是关于做出决定并对其后果承担责任。

可以生成代码。 责任不能。

现代软件正在变得概率化

应用程序本身内部还发生了另一个令人着迷的变化。

几十年来，大多数业务逻辑都是确定性的。 给定相同的输入和相同的状态，我们每次都期望相同的输出。

人工智能引入了一些不同的东西。

应用程序现在可以在运行时进行推理、解释自然语言、对信息进行分类、总结文档、生成内容、选择工具并根据上下文做出决策。

我们系统的某些部分正在变得概率性而非纯粹的确定性。

这创造了一个全新的工程决策类别。

我们应该在哪里使用法学硕士，传统职能在哪里是更好的解决方案？ 我们如何测试输出可以合法改变的东西？ 我们如何评价它的质量？ 我们如何在生产中对其进行监控？ 多少变化是可以接受的？ 当模型产生意外结果时会发生什么？

我们在运行时引入的智能越多，这些问题就变得越重要。

人工智能并不会通过提供智能组件来消除工程决策。

它创造了新的。

人工智能不会消除工程决策。 它创造了新的。

软件开发人员最大的机会

这是这种演变中让我感到乐观的部分。

多年来，许多自由职业者和顾问基本上都是在销售实施。

客户需要一项功能，我们评估工作量，实施它，并按生产它所需的时间收费。

当实施变得更便宜时，该模型显然会发生变化。

但我不一定认为这是一个问题。

我看到了一个机会。

经验丰富的开发人员可以越来越多地结合人工智能功能、云基础设施、身份验证提供商、支付平台、无头 CMS、部署服务、数据库和专用 API 来构建几年前需要整个团队才能完成的产品。

差异化因素不再仅仅是实现每个组件的能力。

它知道要使用哪些组件，如何组合它们，什么应该自定义，什么根本不应该构建，最重要的是，哪个问题实际上值得解决。

这使开发人员更加接近产品。

我们可以销售解决方案，而不是只销售实施。 我们可以参与定义应该构建的内容并拥有结果，而不是接收规范并将其转换为代码。

这就是为什么我喜欢“构建者”这个词。

构建者并不是由他们亲自编写了多少代码来定义的。

构建者了解问题、设计解决方案、选择正确的工具、编排各个部分、评估结果并掌控接下来发生的事情。

从这个角度来看我们的职业，我不认为未来的软件开发人员创造的价值会减少。

我认为我们创造价值的方式不同。

更少的执行，更多的意图。

更少的打字，更多的决策。

更多编排。

更多所有权。

我们行业的每一次重大转变都提高了抽象水平，但并没有消除对优秀工程师的需求。 人工智能正在做同样的事情，但其规模和速度可能是我们以前从未经历过的。

它并不是要求我们变得不那么技术化。 它让我们有机会在更高的水平上应用我们的技术知识，在这个水平上，理解系统、做出正确的决策和掌握所有权更加重要。

这并不是软件开发的结束。

这是软件开发人员的下一个发展。
